reconstruction.scope: All five Monolith bodies and upgrade overlays, shared base/scaffold/ruin, three projectile tiers, every referenced particle export and eight referenced sounds.
reconstruction.controls: turret selects one of 16 directional attack clips across 360 source frames; d1..d16 select the attack clip phase; projectile_0..2 are the three orb tiers (min, med, max). Direction mapping and orb-tier naming are local interpretations checked against rendered views.
reconstruction.preview: Base plus body at turret frame 225 with orb tier 3, frame zero, density two; registration is local.
